

You conjure a howling blizzard of swirling clouds of ice and snow which fills a 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centred at a point you can see within range. The area becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain. Any creature that starts their turn within the area or enters it for the first time during the turn must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 6d8 cold damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much on a successful one.

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 6th.
